entities.name: Auguste Étienne François Mayer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Auguste Étienne François Mayer was a French painter and lithographer who specialized in marine art, especially ships and naval battles. He participated in several Arctic scientific expeditions and painted scenes from these expeditions. He first exhibited an oil painting at the Paris Salon in 1824 and continued to exhibit there regularly through 1869.
